description: 한국전자통신연구원_표정 인식 API [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 표정인식 기술은 이미지에서 사람의 표정을 인식하고 행복, 분노, 역겨움, 공포, 슬픔, 놀람, 중립, 졸림, 싫음, 평안의 10가지 표정으로 분류하는 기술입니다. 다양한 연령대와 성별을 고려하여 한국인을 대상으로 데이터를 구축하고 학습한 결과입니다. 분류 가능한 표정(10가지) 행복,분노,역겨움,공포,슬... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 표정인식, 이미지 인식, 한국인, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
